response.query: What detailed costing plan (per-household subsidy, delivery, monitoring, lab costs) and what cost-effectiveness metrics (cost per serving, DALY, benefit–cost) will we use to inform scale-up?
response.answer: The costing plan includes per-household subsidy, delivery, monitoring, and lab costs. Cost-effectiveness metrics will use cost per serving, DALY, and benefit–cost ratios.
